_comment: OAuth accounts that are permanently gone. Discovery skips them so check_infra does not block on a login nobody can perform, and account-spec expansion drops them so --account 1-5 never dispatches work to them. Removing an entry here restores the account everywhere.

reasons.2: Access lost 2026-07-23, not recoverable. ~/.claude-homes/account2 still exists (unrelated state) but holds no credentials.
